name: contract-json-format
goal: Keep generated entity contracts both registry-canonical and Prettier-clean

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Indexing rewrites 12 migrated manifests because stableJson differs from Prettier for arrays containing empty containers and nested primitive arrays. Formatting those manifests makes registry checks stale. Existing style examples covered primitive arrays and nonempty object arrays but missed those admitted JSON shapes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen the existing stableJson Prettier-style Example with empty-container and nested-array matrices, width boundaries and direct getter/species/iterator observation. Preserve all 12 Example names, IDs, outcomes and existing assertion boundaries; no new test case.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed 627512c0187e retains red 3c1d522a9ef8: the existing Prettier-style Example fails generated JSON must match project Prettier style, with 11 other Examples passing. Original raw getter/species/iterator/prototype observations pass before the product mismatch.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Compact only already-rendered valid JSON arrays containing primitives, empty objects or recursively eligible arrays when their full line fits. Preserve the existing original-input traversal and invalid-result fallback; never format by rereading raw getters or normalizing caller objects.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Product commit 0c82901c1984 compacts only rendered JSON snapshots. Existing caller getter reads, original array map/species accesses, ignored iterator and prototype are unchanged. All 12 authored Example cases pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched harbor-mbp-2 red 7ef6972c3eac at 627512c0187e fails the existing style Example, with 11 passes; green d7fdcce01ae2 at 0c82901c1984 passes the same unchanged 12 cases, command, fixtures and expectations under the same guarded reservation.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Clean old-source snapshot 627512c0187e fails generated JSON must match project Prettier style; repaired snapshot 0c82901c1984 passes. Compiler, focused lint and 32 relevant method/example/ownership/readability checks pass on harbor-mbp-2. Registry/format reindex and full aggregate qualification remain pending.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
